# Real tool files for the FBX tests

Files written by Autodesk Maya and 3ds Max, with the frames those tools wrote out as OBJ, taken unchanged from the `data`
folder of https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx at commit 1d097696e33b367bb3152b175aeb2d95193f9b6e. Licence: MIT or public domain (Unlicense), at the user's
choice; Copyright (c) 2020 Samuli Raivio. They are test data only, are not in any npm tarball, and no code of that
repository is used or was read.
